statement: Function.Injective (Chevalley.mu p M) ∧ Nonempty (Module.Basis (Chevalley.Index ell) (Chevalley.R p) (Chevalley.MR p M)) ∧ Submodule.span ℂ (Chevalley.image p M) = ⊤
proof:
classical
letI := Module.compHom V (algebraMap (Chevalley.R p) ℂ)
letI : IsScalarTower (Chevalley.R p) ℂ V := IsScalarTower.of_compHom _ _ _
obtain ⟨d, b, B, hb⟩ := h_H004.1
have hd : d = ell.toNat + 1 := by
  have hh := Module.finrank_eq_card_basis B
  simpa [h_H002.2.1] using hh.symm
let eqi : Fin d ≃ Chevalley.Index ell := finCongr hd
let b' := b.reindex eqi
let B' := B.reindex eqi
have hb' (i : Chevalley.Index ell) : (b' i : V) = B' i := by
  simpa [b', B'] using hb (eqi.symm i)
let c := b'.baseChange (Chevalley.R p)
have hc (i : Chevalley.Index ell) : Chevalley.mu p M (c i) = B' i := by
  simp [c, Chevalley.mu, hb']
have hinj : Function.Injective (fun r : Chevalley.R p => r • (1 : ℂ)) :=
  @yui_aux_0002 V instV instCV K instK p ell x y h v M h_H001 h_H002 h_H004 h_T004
have hli : LinearIndependent (Chevalley.R p) (fun i => Chevalley.mu p M (c i)) := by
  simpa only [hc] using B'.linearIndependent.restrict_scalars hinj
have hi : Function.Injective (Chevalley.mu p M) :=
  LinearMap.injective_of_linearIndependent (f := Chevalley.muR p M) c.span_eq hli
refine ⟨hi, ⟨c⟩, ?_⟩
apply (Submodule.eq_top_iff_forall_basis_mem B').mpr
intro i
apply Submodule.subset_span
exact ⟨c i, hc i⟩

checked : ∀ (V : Type) [instV : AddCommGroup V] [instCV : _root_.Module ℂ V] (K : Type) [instK : Field K] (p : ℕ)
  (ell : ℤ) (x y h : Module.End ℂ V) (v : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  Nat.Prime p ∧ CharP K p ∧ 0 ≤ ell ∧ ell < ↑p →
    (FiniteDimensional ℂ V ∧
        Module.finrank ℂ V = ell.toNat + 1 ∧
          h * x - x * h = 2 • x ∧
            h * y - y * h = -2 • y ∧
              x * y - y * x = h ∧
                (∃ w, w ≠ 0 ∧ x w = 0 ∧ h w = ↑ell • w) ∧
                  ∀ (W : Submodule ℂ V),
                    Chevalley.stable W x → Chevalley.stable W y → Chevalley.stable W h → W = ⊥ ∨ W = ⊤) →
      ((∃ d b B, ∀ (i : Fin d), ↑(b i) = B i) ∧
          ∀ (r : ℕ), Chevalley.preserves M (Chevalley.dp x r) ∧ Chevalley.preserves M (Chevalley.dp y r)) →
        0 < ell.toNat + 1 ∧
            Fintype.card (Chevalley.Index ell) = ell.toNat + 1 ∧
              Module.finrank ℂ V = ell.toNat + 1 ∧
                ((∀ (t : ℕ), h ((y ^ t) v) = (↑ell - 2 * ↑t) • (y ^ t) v) ∧
                    ∀ (t : ℕ), 0 < t → x ((y ^ t) v) = (↑t * (↑ell - ↑t + 1)) • (y ^ (t - 1)) v) ∧
                  (∃ b, ∀ (i : Chevalley.Index ell), b i = Chevalley.e y v ↑i) ∧
                    (∀ (t : ℕ), ell.toNat < t → (y ^ t) v = 0) ∧
                      Chevalley.stringActions ell x y h (Chevalley.e y v) ∧
                        Chevalley.dividedActions ell (Chevalley.dp x) (Chevalley.dp y) (Chevalley.e y v) →
          Function.Injective (Chevalley.mu p M) ∧
            Nonempty (Module.Basis (Chevalley.Index ell) (↥(Chevalley.R p)) (Chevalley.MR p M)) ∧
              Submodule.span ℂ (Chevalley.image p M) = ⊤
